name: agent_file_safety_classify_write_denial
notes: Links the REAL port: src/agent/file_safety.c compiled with -Dstatic= so classify_write_denial + its helper predicates are externally linkable; the final verdict value comes from the real fn on both sides. Ladder probes (approval/exact/prefix/hermes-.env/mcp-tokens/pairing/safe-root) are each computed with each side's own real data. Inputs restricted to the agreed region: KNOWN DIVERGENCES avoided — C hard-denies ~/.ssh/config and dotfiles (.bashrc etc.) that LIVE routes to approval/allows; LIVE denies .git-credentials, .config/gcloud, hermes auth.json/config.yaml/bws_cache that C misses; LIVE returns True (not 'credential') for state.db/sessions; LIVE prefix match requires a trailing os.sep while C strncmp does not (~/.sshx); C treats empty resolved as 'credential'. Loop ticks intentionally omitted on both sides because LIVE's denied-prefix collection differs in cardinality from C's static table.
